card.name: Linking words before additive or synergistic effects
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, are, were, have a) right after additive or interacting drugs, where the next word is likely 'synergistic', 'potentiating' or 'additive'. Also the 'y' inside 'tachyphylaxis'.

modes.label: 'or' after additive
modes.description: The word 'or' after 'additive' or 'synergistic' in drug interaction text, just before 'potentiating' or 'antagonist'.
modes.example: the possibility of an additive<< or>> potentiating effect with Central Nerv

modes.label: Verb after interacting drugs
modes.description: A verb or article after two named drugs or effects, where 'additive' or 'synergistic' is expected next.
modes.example: The CNS depressant effects of Tizanidine Tablets, USP and alcohol<< are>> additive.

modes.label: Inside tachyphylaxis
modes.example: should be aware of the possibility of tach<<y>>phylaxis and should be prepared

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'sy' words such as synergy or synergistic.
card.plain: It fires in drug interaction text when the next word is likely to be 'synergistic' or a similar word about combined effects.
